canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sorted object keys; compact separators; Unicode retained; no trailing LF; streaming rows length-prefixed with unsigned 64-bit big-endian byte length

query_contract.actions_keyset_sql_utf8: SELECT v.vote_event_id AS action_id,v.vote_date AS action_date,v.title AS action_label,v.source_id,v.source_record_pk,sr.source_record_id,sr.source_snapshot_date,substr(v.vote_event_id,5) AS official_action_url,v.source_url AS source_page_url,sr.content_sha256 AS source_record_content_sha256 FROM parl_vote_events v JOIN source_records sr ON sr.source_record_pk=v.source_record_pk WHERE v.source_id=? AND sr.source_snapshot_date=? AND v.vote_date IS NOT NULL AND trim(v.vote_date)<>'' AND (v.vote_date>? OR (v.vote_date=? AND v.vote_event_id>?)) ORDER BY v.vote_date,v.vote_event_id LIMIT ?
query_contract.members_keyset_sql_utf8: SELECT m.vote_event_id AS action_id,m.member_vote_id,m.seat,m.member_name,m.member_name_normalized,CAST(m.person_id AS TEXT) AS person_id,m.group_code,m.vote_choice,m.source_id,m.source_url,m.source_snapshot_date FROM parl_vote_member_votes m JOIN parl_vote_events v ON v.vote_event_id=m.vote_event_id JOIN source_records sr ON sr.source_record_pk=v.source_record_pk WHERE v.source_id=? AND sr.source_snapshot_date=? AND v.vote_date IS NOT NULL AND trim(v.vote_date)<>'' AND (m.vote_event_id>? OR (m.vote_event_id=? AND m.member_vote_id>?)) ORDER BY m.vote_event_id,m.member_vote_id LIMIT ?
query_contract.series_keyset_sql_utf8: SELECT s.indicator_series_id,s.canonical_key,s.label AS series_label,json_extract(s.dimensions_json,'$.dataset_code') AS dataset_code,json_extract(s.dimensions_json,'$.series_dimensions.geo') AS geography_code,s.frequency AS frequency_code,s.unit AS unit_code,s.dimensions_json,s.source_id,s.source_record_pk,sr.source_record_id,sr.source_snapshot_date,s.source_url AS official_source_url,sr.content_sha256 AS source_record_content_sha256,json_extract(s.raw_payload,'$.origin_capture_sha256') AS origin_capture_sha256 FROM indicator_series s JOIN source_records sr ON sr.source_record_pk=s.source_record_pk WHERE s.source_id=? AND sr.source_snapshot_date=? AND s.frequency=? AND json_extract(s.dimensions_json,'$.series_dimensions.geo') GLOB ? AND s.indicator_series_id>? ORDER BY s.indicator_series_id LIMIT ?
query_contract.points_keyset_sql_utf8: SELECT p.indicator_series_id,p.date,p.indicator_point_id,CAST(p.value AS TEXT) AS value_decimal,p.value_text FROM indicator_points p JOIN indicator_series s ON s.indicator_series_id=p.indicator_series_id JOIN source_records sr ON sr.source_record_pk=s.source_record_pk WHERE s.source_id=? AND sr.source_snapshot_date=? AND s.frequency=? AND json_extract(s.dimensions_json,'$.series_dimensions.geo') GLOB ? AND (p.indicator_series_id>? OR (p.indicator_series_id=? AND (p.date>? OR (p.date=? AND p.indicator_point_id>?)))) ORDER BY p.indicator_series_id,p.date,p.indicator_point_id LIMIT ?
